prose: Alibaba says it plans to build its first cloud regions in Turkey, Finland and the Netherlands over the next 12 months, Bloomberg reports. The move accelerates its data-center expansion in Europe and the Middle East amid escalating US-China AI tensions.
highlights: Alibaba plans first cloud regions in Turkey, Finland and the Netherlands within 12 months.
The build-out accelerates its Europe and Middle East data-center expansion.
It comes amid escalating US-China AI tensions.
